title: Valverde valley · current playtest
description: The version the team is testing now: a wildfire in the synthetic Valverde valley, run turn by turn by the EXCON while players answer in free text.
scenario: Valverde valley (synthetic territory) and its scenario packs
highlights: Players are narrative-only: the AI reads each reply and suggests catalogue actions that the EXCON executes, edits or ignores
Queued and scheduled EXCON actions, including ExtinguishArea on a drawn polygon
Every participant chooses a language when a new exercise starts
Session, scenario packs and OpenRouter key are kept in this browser

modes.name: Full exercise
modes.description: Launcher, EXCON console, every player role and the 3D simulator in one browser window.

modes.name: Interaction bench
modes.description: EXCON and player screens of one small workflow side by side, against a fake server, to try the message flow between users.

modes.name: Simulator bench
modes.description: 3D simulator next to the EXCON control console: run, pause or jump the clock and apply actions at once. Nothing is saved.

modes.name: Scenario editor 3D
modes.description: Edit a complete scenario draft, terrain, roads and objects included, without starting an exercise.
